player.name: Azra
player.description: Azra, athletic hobgoblin variant (wolf- and bear-touched). No tusks. Taller than a human male, long powerful limbs, dense muscle, enhanced senses, tougher skin. Deeply bonded with Elena after months together.

stats.notes: Further refined by a month of daily training. Name now Azra.

genitalia.penis: 11 inches erect, thick, heavy, broad head

elena.disposition: deeply intertwined love-adjacent dependence and closeness
elena.notes: Month of daily life, training, hunting, and intimacy has further solidified the bond. She knows him as Azra.

elena.name: Elena
elena.notes: Knows his name as Azra. Continues shared life in the house.
